films.desc_en: A premium spa commercial following a woman's relaxing journey in a luxurious wellness center inspired by Macedonian nature.
films.music: Calm, relaxing ambient spa music with soft chimes, 60 bpm
vo_mk: Препуштете се на врвно спа искуство.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white linen robe, stands on a wooden terrace overlooking the stunning Canyon Matka. The water is deep green, surrounded by towering rocky cliffs. Soft morning sunlight illuminates her face. Shot with a 50mm lens, cinematic composition, photorealistic, serene atmosphere.
shots.motion: The woman breathes in deeply as her hair blows gently in the wind. The camera slowly pushes in towards her face.

shots.kf: The same 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white linen robe, walks slowly down a luxurious spa corridor. Warm ambient light glows from wall sconces, illuminating the smooth stone walls and wooden floor. Photorealistic, wide tracking shot, elegant and calm.
shots.motion: The woman walks forward gracefully in slow motion. The camera slowly tracks backward to reveal more of the elegant hallway.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair relaxes in a bubbling hydrotherapy tub, visible only from the shoulders up. Gentle steam rises around her against a backdrop of dark slate tiles and flickering candles. Photorealistic, intimate close-up, 85mm lens, warm and relaxing mood.
shots.motion: Gentle bubbles ripple across the surface of the water as steam rises slowly. The camera slowly pans right.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing her white linen robe, sits by a large window. Her skin is glowing and radiant. Soft natural light wraps around her features, creating a deeply peaceful expression. Photorealistic, medium portrait, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion: The woman smiles softly and closes her eyes in complete relaxation. The camera slowly dollies in for an intimate feel.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, in a white linen robe, holds a ceramic cup of herbal tea on a sunny balcony. Lush green trees and a clear blue sky form the background. Photorealistic, bright and airy color palette, premium lifestyle photography.
shots.motion: Steam rises from the ceramic cup as she brings it slightly closer to her chest. The camera tilts up slowly.

films.line_en: Be the best version of yourself.
films.desc_en: A stylish commercial showcasing a modern barbershop experience for men in a vintage cobblestone setting.
films.music: Cool, rhythmic jazz hop with a confident bassline, 90 bpm

shots.kf: A 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt stands in front of a vintage barbershop in the Old Bazaar of Skopje. The cobblestone street and old wooden doors create a timeless, premium atmosphere. Cinematic lighting, photorealistic, wide shot.
shots.motion: The man looks thoughtfully at the storefront, standing completely still. The camera slowly pushes in towards the wooden doors.

shots.kf: The same 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt sits in a classic leather barber chair. He gazes into a large, ornate mirror. Warm amber bulbs illuminate the premium interior. Photorealistic, over-the-shoulder shot, 50mm lens, moody tones.
shots.motion: The man turns his head slightly to examine his profile in the mirror. The camera slowly pans to the left.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair and a black button-down shirt relaxes with a steaming hot towel wrapped over his face. Warm, moody lighting highlights the steam rising in the premium barbershop interior. Photorealistic, medium close-up, rich shadows and gold highlights.
shots.motion: Thick steam rises slowly from the hot towel as the man breathes steadily. The camera slowly dollies forward.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt sits proudly in the chair, looking sharp and refreshed. A vintage grooming brush rests on the marble counter in the foreground. Photorealistic, 85mm lens, crisp focus on his confident face.
shots.motion: The man smiles confidently, radiating fresh energy. The camera slowly glides to the right, keeping his face perfectly in frame.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt walks down a sunny cobblestone street in Skopje. He looks exceptionally sharp and stylish. The background features blurred historical architecture. Photorealistic, golden hour lighting, full-body tracking shot.
shots.motion: The man walks forward with a confident, steady stride. The camera tracks backward smoothly to follow his movement.

films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical social media ad featuring a luxurious splashing skincare serum.
films.music: Upbeat, trendy electronic dance beat with heavy bass, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Ослободете ја вашата природна убавина уште денес!

shots.kf: A sleek, glowing glass serum bottle hovers in mid-air over a dark marble pedestal. Dramatic spotlighting illuminates the rich amber and gold tones of the luxurious cosmetic liquid inside. Photorealistic, macro photography lens, vertical composition, highly detailed and premium aesthetic.
shots.motion: The glowing glass bottle rotates very slowly in mid-air. The camera slowly tilts up to emphasize the premium design.

shots.kf: Liquid golden serum splashes elegantly around the glowing glass bottle, frozen in a beautiful arc. Tiny droplets catch the dramatic studio light, creating a dynamic and energetic vertical composition. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high contrast with deep black and vibrant gold tones.
shots.motion: The golden liquid ripples and flows smoothly around the stationary bottle. The camera slowly pushes in on the splashing droplets.

shots.kf: A beautiful woman's face is perfectly centered in the vertical frame, showcasing incredibly glowing, flawless skin. She looks directly at the camera with a subtle, confident smile. Soft studio lighting highlights her cheekbones. Photorealistic, portrait lens, bright and clean aesthetic.
shots.motion: The woman slowly turns her face slightly towards the light, enhancing the natural glow of her skin. The camera slowly dollies backward.

films.line_en: The power of nature for you.
films.desc_en: An informative process explainer detailing the benefits and texture of an organic mineral face mask.
films.music: Inspiring, light acoustic corporate track with gentle piano, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Запознајте ја моќта на природните минерали за вашата кожа.
Нашата нова маска длабински ги чисти порите и нечистотиите.
Богатата текстура нежно се нанесува и ја хидрира кожата.
Резултатот е блескаво, чисто и младолико лице секој ден.

shots.kf: A frosted glass jar containing a vibrant green clay mask rests on wet dark slate stones. Soft, natural morning light creates gentle reflections on the glass. The setting evokes a serene, natural environment. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, macro lens, crisp and clean.
shots.motion: Water droplets gently trickle down the dark slate stones. The camera slowly pans to the right across the glass jar.

shots.kf: A extreme close-up view of raw, textured green mineral rocks surrounded by fresh, sparkling water droplets and delicate, vibrant fern leaves. Earthy green and dark grey tones dominate the scene, highlighting the natural purity of the ingredients. Photorealistic, macro lens, incredibly detailed and organic composition.
shots.motion: A soft mist rolls slowly over the textured green rocks and fern leaves. The camera slowly tilts down to reveal more details.

shots.kf: The thick, creamy texture of a green mineral mask is swirled beautifully inside a clear glass bowl. Studio lighting perfectly highlights the smooth, luxurious peaks of the cream against a pure white background. Photorealistic, 85mm lens, extremely sharp focus on the texture.
shots.motion: The creamy texture catches the light as the bowl slowly rotates on a invisible turntable. The camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: A smooth wooden spatula rests on the edge of a clear glass bowl, heavily coated in the rich green mask. The minimalist setup features a pristine white marble counter and soft, diffused studio lighting. Photorealistic, commercial product photography, exceptionally clean.
shots.motion: The wooden spatula remains perfectly still while the background lighting subtly shifts from left to right. The camera slowly tracks backward.

shots.kf: A woman's cheek and jawline are covered in an even, perfectly smooth layer of the green clay mask. Soft side lighting emphasizes the rich texture of the product against a neutral beige backdrop. Photorealistic, tight close-up, highly realistic skin and product details.
shots.motion: The woman's head slowly turns a few degrees to the right, showing the flawless application of the mask. The camera remains perfectly still.

shots.kf: A magnificent slow-motion splash of crystal-clear water frozen in mid-air against a pristine white background. The pure, refreshing water catches the bright studio light brilliantly, creating sparkling highlights and crisp, elegant details. High-speed photography style, photorealistic, dynamic, energetic, and extremely clean.
shots.motion: The water droplets hang in the air, moving in ultra-slow motion to emphasize purity. The camera slowly pans across the splash.

shots.kf: A beautiful woman's face bathed in soft golden hour sunlight, her skin looking incredibly fresh, clean, and radiant. The background is a softly blurred, tranquil lake landscape inspired by Ohrid. Photorealistic, 85mm portrait composition, warm and inviting atmosphere, completely flawless skin.
shots.motion: The woman smiles warmly while the golden sunlight flickers softly across her radiant face. The camera slowly dollies in for a captivating finish.

films.desc_en: A seamless before and after visual journey showing the upgrading of a beauty space.
films.music: Uplifting, magical ambient swell building to a bright finish, 80 bpm
vo_mk: Доживејте целосна трансформација во нашиот нов салон.
Совршен простор за вашата совршена убавина.

shots.kf: A dim, outdated beauty salon waiting area with worn-out brown leather chairs, faded yellow walls, and poor fluorescent lighting. The space looks tired and unwelcoming, with old magazines scattered on a dull wooden coffee table. Photorealistic, wide shot, muted and gloomy color palette.
shots.end_kf: A bright, luxurious modern beauty clinic waiting area with plush white velvet chairs, pristine cream walls, and warm ambient LED lighting. The space is elegant and inviting, featuring a sleek marble coffee table with fresh orchids. Photorealistic, wide shot, premium and radiant aesthetic.
shots.motion: The lighting shifts dramatically from dim to bright as the room transforms. The camera slowly pushes in towards the center of the waiting area.

shots.kf: A highly cluttered and messy vanity makeup station featuring an old, scratched mirror. Dozens of half-empty, cheap plastic cosmetic bottles are scattered haphazardly across a badly stained wooden counter under harsh, unappealing overhead light. Photorealistic, medium shot, chaotic and disorganized atmosphere.
shots.end_kf: A perfectly organized, premium vanity station featuring a glowing LED mirror. A carefully curated selection of high-end minimalist glass skincare bottles sits elegantly on a pristine white marble counter under soft, flattering studio light. Photorealistic, medium shot, serene and luxurious atmosphere.
shots.motion: The clutter fades away into perfect organization as the lighting becomes soft and beautiful. The camera slowly dollies to the right.

shots.kf: A basic, uninviting spa massage bed covered in a thin, wrinkled white sheet. The room is completely bare, with plain grey walls, harsh shadows, and no decorative elements, creating a cold and clinical environment. Photorealistic, wide shot, flat and uninspiring lighting.
shots.end_kf: A luxurious, deeply relaxing spa massage bed topped with thick, fluffy towels, scattered rose petals, and glowing candles. The room features warm wooden accents, soft amber lighting, and an aura of absolute tranquility. Photorealistic, wide shot, rich and inviting cinematic lighting.
shots.motion: The harsh lighting melts into a warm, glowing amber tone while the bed transforms. The camera slowly tilts down towards the massage bed.

shots.kf: A dusty, empty retail display shelf in a salon made of cheap, chipped laminate wood. The lighting is dark and shadowy, making the few remaining generic plastic bottles look completely unappealing and forgotten. Photorealistic, close-up shot, depressing and neglected aesthetic.
shots.end_kf: A stunning, illuminated glass and brass display shelf showcasing a perfectly aligned row of premium beauty serums in frosted glass bottles. Brilliant, soft spotlights highlight the luxurious gold caps and rich liquid inside. Photorealistic, close-up shot, highly premium and elegant aesthetic.
shots.motion: The empty shelves smoothly populate with luxurious glowing bottles as the spotlights turn on. The camera slowly pushes in towards the premium products.
